data.name: Giransh
data.gender_notes: Giransh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Giransh is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'Gira' means 'Lord' and 'Ansh' means 'the universe'. This name signifies the one who holds the entire universe in his/her hands, representing the supreme power and creator of the universe. The name Giransh carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Giransh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine power and creation.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Giransh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
